title: Indian Standard Time Zone
subject: Geography
caption: Map of India showing that the whole nation and its islands follow a single time zone (IST, GMT+5:30).
altText: A textbook-quality illustration on a white background displaying the outline of India and its island territories. The entire area is shaded uniformly and labeled 'IST (GMT+5:30)', indicating a single time zone for the whole country. Major cities like New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, and Port Blair are marked with circles and each shows the same local time, confirming that all locations share Indian Standard Time.
